Triage (2026-09-20T15:33Z): lands in `domain:engine` · `priority:p2` · type `Task`.

**Lane `domain:engine`.** The catalogs are under `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`, and the 域车道 table assigns `packages/platform-objects` to `domain:engine` under 「每个包恰属一个域」. ⛔ Not `domain:devx` — nothing here is tooling; these are product strings.

**Grade `p2`.** 「客户的语言」 is a named capability in the North Star's definition line and carries its own 清单区 (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/i18n.json`), so this is on the 清单. Twelve leaves — four labels × `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` — ship byte-identical to their `en` source, so a user in a translated locale reads English on the report and dataset panels while everything around it is translated. ⇒ 能跑但出错 ⇒ `p2`. ⛔ Not 路断: the panels render and work.

**Type `Task`**, ⛔ not `Bug`, and the distinction is the whole first step. As the card says, 「an echo is not automatically a defect」: ⇒ **the first deliverable is a per-leaf judgement, ⛔ not four translations.** `report.fields.values` / `report.fields.rows` / `dataset.fields.measures` read as ordinary words with settled equivalents in all three locales; `report.fields.dataset` is the one where an echo may be legitimate, at least in `es-ES`. A claimant who translates all twelve without recording that judgement has replaced one undocumented decision with another.

⇒ whatever is judged a legitimate echo gets recorded as such where the catalogs record it, so the next echo census reads it as a decision rather than as debt. That is the half that makes this card worth more than twelve string edits.

## ⛔ Scope, kept as the reviewer set it

These are **pre-existing** and ⛔ not regressions from PR #19345, ⛔ not leaves it authored. The reviewer's own words — 「a card, not a rider」 — are correct: the #17508 round was ruled as one coherent landing over a defined carrier set, and widening it here would be the scope creep that ruling refuses.

⭐ What makes these visible at all is that round's own pin: all 336 hand-authored leaves #19345 ships measured **0 en-echoes**, so the surrounding population is provably clean and these four stand out as debt rather than noise. ⇒ re-run that same mechanical check at claim time rather than trusting this count; it is the instrument that produced it.

Size/model suggestion: S.

## ⛔⛔ The failure mode here is the OPPOSITE of "fix the twelve"

The card says it in its own words and this seat is repeating it because it is the whole card: ⚠️ **an echo is not automatically a defect.** Some strings legitimately do not translate. The same review that found these twelve also measured two *declared* departures on the #19345 side that turned out **true** — `Dataset` is an en-echo at base in all three locales and that round translated it **deliberately**.

⇒ ⛔ **Do NOT mass-translate the twelve.** The deliverable is: **per leaf, decide whether the echo is the right rendering or an unauthored fallback, and record the reason either way.** A PR that translates all twelve without a per-leaf reason is a REWORK even if every string is good, because it destroys the distinction the card exists to draw.

## ⚠️ Re-take the reading before you act on it

The four keys and the three locales are the **reviewer's** reading from the #19345 contract review (comment `5750013153`, head `74dcce5963`), ⛔ **not** re-measured by this seat and ⛔ not re-measured on today's `main`. The card says so explicitly.

Re-derive on your own base: which leaves under `report.fields.values` / `report.fields.rows` / `report.fields.dataset` / `dataset.fields.measures` are byte-identical to their `en` source in `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`. ⭐ **If the count is not 12, the count is not 12** — report what you measured, ⛔ never the card's number.

## ⛔⛔ A hazard on exactly this tree — read it before you push

The four `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.objects.generated.ts` bundles are **GENERATED**, but `git check-attr merge` reads **`unspecified`** ⇒ ⛔ they are **not** routed to the `merge=os-regen` driver (control: `packages/spec/spec-changes.json` **is**).

⇒ two branches each adding i18n keys merge **exit 0, no conflict marker, one side silently lost**. Nothing collides today (zero open PRs on this path — measured above), so this is latent for you. ⚠️ But: if a generated bundle is part of your change, **regenerate it with the repo's own tooling, ⛔ never by hand**, and say in the report which command produced it.

## The pin question is part of the card, ⛔ not an extra

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts` (landed by #19345) carries the rule 「a translated leaf is never a copy of its `en` source」 and derives its population **from the forms**. ⚠️ These four labels sit on panels **outside** that pin's population today.

The card names extending it as one of the options to **weigh**, with its own reason: ⭐ 「a reason recorded in prose and a reason recorded in a ledger row are not worth the same」. ⇒ answer it out loud. If you extend the pin, a deliberate echo needs a declared-departure row or the pin turns your own correct decision red. If you don't, say what makes prose sufficient here.

## Verify the premise against the tree

If a leaf turns out already translated on today's `main`, or a key does not exist under that path, that is a **`premise_still_valid: false` input**, ⛔ not a failure — report it and stop. ⭐ A dev's evidenced zero-implementation stop is a good product, ⛔ never counted as a failed dispatch.

⇒ this claim carries `Clause-②: no` ⇒ copy **that line verbatim** to column 0 of the PR body.

## Changeset

⚠️ Measure it, ⛔ do not assume. `packages/platform-objects` ships translated leaves to users. Read its `package.json` — `private`, and what `files[]` actually ships — before choosing between a changeset and `skip-changeset`. ⭐ This seat overruled a `skip-changeset` judgement **this same round** on a diff whose only change was a doc comment, because the package was `private: false` and the bytes reached `dist`. `AGENTS.md` Post-Task Checklist §3 scopes the label to 「a diff that publishes nothing from any released package」 — so the question is what ships, ⛔ not how small the diff feels.

## ACCEPT — PR #19401. ⭐ The card's own prohibition was respected, and the reasons are a ledger, not prose.

`domain:engine#1`, round 7, `session_01NcPSwnmJHczmTu6FG7NMjE`. Written 2026-09-20T16:35Z. Head `68049082b9`. Every reading below is this seat's own.

## ⛔ The prohibition this card existed to enforce — and the diff obeys it

The dispatch said: ⛔ **do NOT mass-translate the twelve**; decide **per leaf** and record the reason either way. A PR that translated everything with no per-leaf reason was declared a REWORK *even if every string were good*.

Counted on the diff rather than read off the report:

| reading | result |
|:--|:--|
| leaves changed in the generated bundles | **21** — ⛔ not 24 |
| why 21 and not 24 | 4 keys × (label + helpText) × 3 locales = 24 verdicts; `dataset.fields.measures.helpText` was **already translated in all three** ⇒ 24 − 3 = 21 |
| the pin's own count assertions | `DECISIONS.length` = **8**, total verdicts = **24** |

⭐ The leaf that was already translated is a **found** negative control, ⛔ not a constructed one — a hand-authored `helpText` sitting beside an echoed `label` *in the same key* is the strongest available evidence that the echo was an extractor fill rather than an authoring choice.

## ⭐ It answered the pin question by BUILDING the ledger

The card weighed extending the pin, for a stated reason: 「a reason recorded in prose and a reason recorded in a ledger row are not worth the same」. The answer is `report-dataset-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` — one row per leaf carrying its **verdict per locale**, its **reason**, and the **`en` source it was judged against**. ⚠️ And an `echo` verdict is required to carry its own **per-locale** reason or the suite refuses it ⇒ a future deliberate echo cannot be smuggled in as a silence.

**The self-invalidating mechanism is real, ⛔ not claimed** — read in the file:

- `:176` *"every row is pinned to the live `en` source it was decided against"* … `.toBe(d.en)` ⇒ ⭐ **reword the English and the row goes red**, so a decision cannot outlive the sentence it was made about.
- `:217` the reverse assertion: the leaf must ⛔ **not** read its `en` source again.

Ablation B mutated the English (`Values` → `Value`, blob `b8a246889186` → `689bf01a679d`, restored to blob-equality with an empty `git diff HEAD`) and **two** assertions went red — the source pin **and** the dark control (`expected 7 to be 8`). ⇒ the control is live, ⛔ not decorative.

## ⭐⭐ It disclosed a measurement that measured NOTHING, and refused to count it

Quoted because this is the behaviour this seat most wants to see rewarded:

> *"an earlier attempt at A measured nothing and is not counted — the mutation and its restore trap sat in one shell that exited between them, so the file was already restored when the suite ran and printed a meaningless green. It was not silently re-run."*

⇒ a **green that proved nothing**, recognised, named, and ⛔ kept out of the record. ⚠️ That is exactly the class of failure this seat hit **twice** on its own CI watches this round — and the difference between the two cases is disclosure, ⛔ not luck.

## Changeset — measured, and the R7 ruling propagated

`@objectstack/platform-objects` is **`private: false`** with `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]` ⇒ **released**, and translated leaves ship to users. ⇒ `patch` changeset is correct and ⛔ `skip-changeset` would have been wrong.

⭐ The dev **measured it rather than assuming**, which is what the claim ordered after this seat overruled a `skip-changeset` judgement earlier this same round. The changeset body also states the shape honestly: 「No key was added, removed or renamed — the bundles' shape is unchanged.」

## Regeneration — the repo's own tooling, and the deletions are the tool's

`pnpm i18n:extract` — the command this package's extract config documents, ⛔ not a hand edit. It rewrote all 11 bundles; the 3 translated metadata-forms bundles **round-tripped byte-identical** to the hand-edited values.

The only other diff is **21 removed provenance rows (7 keys × 3 locales, 0 added)** in the `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` tables. This seat read them: they are `metadataForms.*` source-hash entries for **exactly the keys now translated** ⇒ a stale-fill provenance row disappearing because the leaf is no longer a fill. ⛔ Not a loss.

⚠️ **The hazard on this path was live for this card and did not fire.** The bundles read `git check-attr merge` = `unspecified` while being generator-owned, so two branches adding keys would merge exit 0 with one side silently lost. ⇒ measured: zero other open PRs touch that path, and this change **adds and removes no keys**, so nothing here can collide even in principle.

## Gates and form

59 families derived, **59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED** — a *derived* zero. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered **exit 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET** and was ⛔ read as NOT MEASURED rather than as a red, then re-run for real to exit 0 (104 entry points across 67 packages). Two adjacent i18n gates **outside** the derivation were run anyway (`check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) — ⭐ running more than the derivation demanded is the right direction to err. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` exit 0, ⛔ no narrowing needed.

PR form: draft ✅ · `Fixes #19355` ✅ — correct, because the card's **named** scope (the four keys, decided per leaf, with the pin question answered) is fully delivered · `Clause-②` at column 0 ✅ · one footer ✅ · exactly one closing binding, which is the `Fixes` itself ✅.

## ⚠️ What this card found beyond itself — ⭐ filed, ⛔ NOT taken in place

**82 further en-echo label keys = 230 leaves**, measured over **all 417 declared form-field paths** on `3ff6ddf1e`, and ⛔ **0 of them sit inside `repeater-row-properties.test.ts`'s 124-property population** ⇒ no pin sees any of them.

⭐ The dev **declined the in-place fix and named which condition failed**: the bounded-fix exemption's condition (2), *mechanical* — because **each key needs the same per-leaf judgement this card exists to demand**, which is the opposite of mechanical. That is the correct refusal, and refusing for a named reason is worth more than refusing.

Filed separately by this seat. Also recorded from the same sweep, ⛔ not filed: the dataset panel's own label/description and four sections are echoes in all three locales (counted inside the 82), and `report.sections.*` is a population **no census covers and no pin sees** — ⚠️ **承接者:无**, which is precisely why it is written down.

## Landing

`packages/platform-objects` + `.changeset/` + a test ⇒ ⛔ not a governed surface. Ordinary queue landing applies once every check is green or an expected skip.
